title.narrative: Provision of Safe Drinking Water through Drilling Complete Solar-Powered Artesian Wells in the Republic of Mali

description.narrative: Drilling of 10 medium-depth artesian wells, maintaining a safe and sound environment and sustaining project activities through periodic maintenance, while limiting the spread of epidemic diseases and raising citizens' awareness of a clean and healthy environment, for 14,000 beneficiaries.

Provide water fit for drinking and human use, preserve its sources, and contribute to reducing water-related diseases and deaths, in order to improve life in rural areas and support the settlement of the indigenous population of the targeted areas who lack access to safe drinking water.
Providing safe drinking water sources for areas in need in the Republic of Mali through the drilling of 10 complete medium-depth solar-powered artesian wells.
